description:

Join to apply for the Finance Reporting Analyst role at Netcracker Technology

If digital transformation , next generation technology and growth opportunities excite you, then apply to join our Netcracker Technology Team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams , earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world. .
What is in it for you?
At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren't micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.
What is the scope of this role?
As part of Finance Global Business Support, the Financial Reporting Analyst of Business Profitability Management will provide financial reporting and operational support to Senior Management, Regional General Managers and supporting organizations. Main responsibility is to provide transparency and trustworthy reporting for incoming deals and ongoing projects to help senior management make strategic and tactical decisions for the company. Candidate will be responsible for accuracy in financial reporting, mainly concentrating on actuals and forecast to allow successful completion of strategic initiatives to continuously improve company's profitability and efficiency. In this role, candidate will work closely with operational groups indicating trends, findings, issues and steps needed to ensure data accuracy in the systems and reporting. Additionally, candidate will assist in driving business process and system enhancements related to all aspects of global business to streamline internal processes.
What are the Role and Responsibilities?

  • Global Business Consolidation reporting, analytics and distribution to Executives and Senior Management
  • Support monthly forecasting, actuals and variance analysis
  • Prepare KPI Decks and present all significant bookings, revenue and profit risks to Senior Management
  • Partnering with BPM Managers and analysts on a global scale to identify trends and issues requiring data adjustments to properly reflect Customer Booking, Revenue and Profitability Forecast
  • Review and evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal processes and manage risk by identifying opportunities to strengthen, rewrite and implement new risk conscious business processes
  • Define business requirements, test and implement an extensive ERP-based automated profitability reporting and analysis tool that enhances the accuracy, flexibility and timeliness of profitability forecasting
  • Perform ad-hoc reports and analysis as needed
What skills are required for this role?
  • Strong financial analysis skills with ability to manipulate large data sets in Excel (knowledge of Macros preferred)
  • Experience in Data Analytics, ability to extrapolate trends from large data sets
  • 3+ years combined experience in Financial/Business Operations
  • Profitability / P&L analysis and reporting experience
  • Accounting (US GAAP/IFRS) and Revenue Recognition experience a plus
  • Proficient in PowerBI or other BI tools
  • Hands-on experience in SQL, VBA, Big Data Analytics
  • Experience in use of ERP systems
  • Experience working in large multinational software and/or IT services company
  • A team player, with ability to work independently, as well as cross-functionally at all levels including interfacing with Senior Management
  • Robust communication skills both verbal and written
  • Ability to meet deadlines and satisfy needs with multiple and conflicting priorities
  • Fluent English both written and oral
  • Availability to work from office in Hybrid mode
Education
  • BS in Accounting/Finance, MBA a plus

title: Gerente de Trade Categoria
description:
ID da Requisição: 67594

SOBRE A WHIRLPOOL CORPORATION

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) é uma empresa líder em eletrodomésticos para cozinha e lavanderia, em constante busca por melhorar a vida em casa e inspirar gerações com nossas marcas. A empresa está impulsionando inovações significativas para atender às crescentes necessidades dos consumidores, por meio do portfólio de marcas icônicas, incluindo Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul e InSinkErator. Em 2023, a empresa registrou aproximadamente US$ 19 bilhões em vendas anuais, 59.000 colaboradores e 55 centros de pesquisa de tecnologia e fabricação. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas em WhirlpoolCorp.com.

A equipe da qual você fará parte

A equipe de Propaganda desenvolve estratégias de marketing, merchandising e criativas e programas afiliados para promover os produtos e serviços da organização através da Internet ou outros canais digitais, para aumentar a exposição e os negócios do público-alvo, e analisa a eficácia dessas estratégias.

Resumo desta função

Será responsável por coordenar as estratégias de sell-out da categoria de lavanderia, enfrentando desafios competitivos frente à concorrência e liderando a execução da renovação de 95% do portfólio até fevereiro de 2026. O papel exige visão estratégica, excelência em execução e forte capacidade analítica.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão

  • Desenvolver e liderar estratégias de sell-out nos canais on/off-line para a categoria de lavanderia.
  • Implementar métodos de gestão e soluções criativas para aumentar a competitividade dos produtos.
  • Gerenciar a transição do portfólio, executando o phase-out de modelos antigos e phase-in dos novos até fev/26.
  • Analisar performance de mercado, concorrência e indicadores de sell-out, propondo planos de ação eficazes.
  • Coordenar o relacionamento com áreas internas e parceiros estratégicos do varejo.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre times de marketing, comercial e supply para execução tática e estratégica.
  • Propor ações comerciais para aumentar margem e atratividade da categoria para o varejo.
  • Monitorar KPIs da categoria e ajustar estratégias conforme necessário.

Requisitos mínimos

  • Profissional em nível de gerência consolidado.

  • Experiência prévia sólida em Trade Marketing, preferencialmente em Trade Categoria.

  • Excel avançado e domínio de ferramentas de análise de mercado, como Nielsen, GfK, Scanntech, Neogrid e dados internos de BI.

  • Capacidade analítica e estratégica para tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

  • Conhecimento profundo em gestão de sell-out e lançamento de produtos.

Habilidades e experiências desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas reconhecidas pela excelência em Trade Marketing no Brasil, como Ambev, P&G, Unilever, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Heineken, Mondelez, Reckitt e Danone.

  • Histórico de atuação em mercados com alta competitividade e transformação constante de portfólio.

  • Vivência em gestão de projetos multifuncionais envolvendo marketing, vendas e supply chain.

  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e negociação com stakeholders internos e externos.

  • Perfil resiliente, proativo e orientado a resultados, com habilidade de atuar do tático ao estratégico.

  • Inglês avançado nice to have, mas não mandatório.

O que oferecemos

_"No dresscode".
_Gympass;
_Vale-Transporte, Fretados ou Estacionamento na empresa;
_Vale Alimentação;
_Refeição no local;
_Benefícios como empréstimo consignado ou social, plano de saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida e previdência privada compatíveis com o mercado;
_Programa de Apoio ao Empregado, contando com atendimento 24hrs com profissionais jurídicos, sociais, financeiros, assistentes sociais e Psicólogos;
_Auxílio Creche ou Berçário na empresa;
_Serviços disponíveis na unidade: salão de beleza e estética, agência bancária interna, lavanderia, lanchonete, restaurante e sala de lactação;
_Duas semanas de trabalho remoto em qualquer lugar;
_Após 5 anos de empresa, colaboradores elegíveis podem tirar quatro semanas de licença remunerada;
_Desconto em produtos pelo Compra Certa.
_Desconto em seguros (pet, auto, residencial, bike, viagem e mais)

We measure and analyze energy utilization to generate empowering analytics for smart grid and infrastructure management, enabling utilities and consumers to reduce energy consumption. About the Role
We are looking for a Power System Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of a cloud-based utility analytics product with embedded power system functionalities. This role offers the opportunity to be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle — from design and implementation to testing and customer support. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to transform market and customer needs into robust software solutions.

Provide technical guidance to the analytics product development team regarding use cases that require power system functionalities such as power flow, optimal power flow, short circuits, transients, stability, arc flash, harmonics, and grounding.

Collaborate with Product Owners to write clear and comprehensive product specifications for design and software teams.

Work closely with technical leads to ensure adherence to product-related system design guidelines.

Leverage deep technical knowledge to propose innovative solutions addressing steady-state and dynamic behaviors of power distribution systems.

Act as a subject matter expert in discussions with clients and partners, addressing queries related to power system analysis within our analytics offering.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Power Engineering. Focus on power distribution, transmission modeling, and analysis (e.g., state estimation, power flow, short circuit analysis, optimization, energy markets) is highly valued.

Experience (2+ years preferred) in electric power engineering, including power system modeling, grid simulations, and operations.

Familiarity with tools for power system studies such as PowerFactory, PSS/E, or equivalent (dynamic and EMT simulation) is a plus.

Experience with software development and scripting (Python preferred) is a strong advantage.

Proven ability to analyze complex technical requirements and translate them into software functionalities.

Ability to work both independently and in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary team environment.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Passion for problem-solving and working in an open, supportive team culture.

Who Are We?

Fidessa (an ION Group Company) provides exceptional trading, investment, and information solutions for the world's financial community. Our unrivalled set of mission-critical products serve both buy-side and sell-side global institutions and investment banks to boutique brokers and niche hedge funds with multi-asset trading and investment infrastructure, their market data and analysis, and their decision making and workflow technology.

We are freethinking and do not believe in rigid structure or tight controls that limit our ability to be innovative and adaptable. Our team at Fidessa is represented within several continents in multiple offices. We recognize that a business is only as good as its people. To provide and build on our high-quality platform and services, we seek to employ only the best!

Role

Fidessa's Trading Support Analysts provide functional support for all customer requests across Fidessa's multi-asset product range. This opening has specific focus around the support and training of new and existing users of the Fidessa equities trading and risk management platform. This platform provides high-speed access to global equities exchanges and execution venues and is used by top tier brokers worldwide. Based in São Paulo, this team is part of the Fidessa Global Service Desk and is formed of an enthusiastic mix of individuals with strong technical, functional, and customer service skills, looking for a challenging and varied role in a fast-paced environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent grad or someone with up to 4 years of experience who wants direct interaction with clients and trading floors, exposure to complex financial products, and a career pathway in trade support, product management, or technical account management.

Responsibilities

In order to meet the requirements of the customer base and the diverse needs of the evolving trading landscape, the Trading Support team caters to the immediate needs of our customers, resolving a high percentage of issues independently and liaising with specialist groups within the business and technology to ensure fast resolution of issues that require additional coordination to resolve. In addition to providing real-time phone, chat, and e-mail support, Trading Support Analysts also conduct regular on-site customer visits to provide product training and support for Fidessa users. These visits provide valuable ground-level insight on how customers are using Fidessa services and can be leveraged to introduce solutions that will help improve customer workflows through new and existing Fidessa solutions. Travel will be required but will be typically less than 25% (when things stabilize after post COVID-19).

Required Experience and Competencies

  • At least 1 year of experience in equities trading operations, including basic knowledge of the equity markets and an understanding of equity business flows. Recent grads with significant internship experience in equities trading operations, equity markets, and equity business flows will also be considered.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating the ability to communicate succinctly and accurately to customers.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering concentration (Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering) with a business focus OR Business-related degree with significant exposure to Information Systems, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering.
  • Self-motivated and positive attitude.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations in a trading environment.
  • Bilingual in Portuguese and English (PLEASE PROVIDE RESUME IN ENGLISH).

Desired Experience and Competencies

  • Experience supporting Software as a Service platforms.
  • Knowledge of financial software platforms.
  • Spoken and written communication skills in Spanish.

About ION

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. More than 40% of the world’s largest companies use our solutions. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading, and risk.

Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

With 10,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe, ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group.

At ION, we offer careers that provide many opportunities: To invent. To design. To collaborate. To build. To transform businesses and empower people around the world to do more, faster and better than before. Imagine what you can do and experience. This is where you can do your best work.

Learn more at iongroup.com .

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.

description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

Job Summary

The Facilities Manager is responsible for strategic and operational team-oriented leadership of the physical plant while working collaboratively with third-party service providers that provide services to the university. The Facilities Manager plans, leads, and coordinates the construction of campus facilities with third-party providers, including facility renewal, maintenance, and repair.

Responsibilities

The primary core responsibilities, as indicated below:

  • Develop long- and short-term plans for the construction, renovation, repair, and maintenance of physical plants, collaborating with third-party service providers.
  • Coordinate with third-party service providers to ensure that renovations, repairs, and maintenance are completed in a timely manner and that facilities are in excellent working order.

  • Provide schedule reports and other feedback as necessary on the progress of construction, renovations, repairs, and maintenance.
  • Support the use of technology to enhance operations, improve the campus infrastructure, and reduce energy costs.
  • Ensure projects are completed on schedule, within budget, and comply with applicable codes and regulations.
  • Provide formal and informal training programs as needed to provide relevant knowledge and skills to plant personnel.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related study, with a preference for a Master’s degree.
  • Five years’ demonstrated experience leading small to large projects.
  • A proven record of leadership in facilities management with budget experience.
  • The ability to lead with both a decisive and consultative style, foster open communications, and proactively build positive relationships.
  • A track record of overseeing the complex construction of campus facilities.
  • A team player who fosters collaboration across the organization and has a commitment to excellence.
  • Physical capacity for prolonged standing, walking and climbing stairs with exposure to outdoor elements.

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

The Aircraft Mechanic II (Engine) repairs, services, and troubleshoots malfunctions on aircraft engine systems (T-700GE-700 or T-55-L-714).

  • Remove and install aircraft engines and engine components.
  • Service and lubricate aircraft and subsystems.
  • Safely prepare aircraft for inspections and maintenance checks and services.
  • Perform scheduled inspections and assist in performing special inspections.
  • Perform limited maintenance operational checks and diagnose and troubleshoot aircraft engine systems using special tools and test equipment as required.
  • Use and perform operator maintenance on tools, special tools, and aircraft ground support equipment.
  • Apply comprehensive technical expertise to solve moderate to complex problems by interpreting technical documentation such as aircraft Technical Manuals, Maintenance Information and Action Messages, and all technical guidance provided through government official representatives.
  • Maintain and repair aircraft engine components.
  • Apply technical knowledge of aircraft engine systems in determining equipment malfunctions and use required expertise in restoring equipment condition and/or operation.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.
  • Perform other duties as requested.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • U.S. military technical school or specialized training course is desired, certification of education level is required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700GE-700 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Or A&P license and two (2) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700-GE-701 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Must be in possession of a U.S. Passport with minimum 2 plus year validity and 6 blank pages, and be able to travel internationally.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain facility Public Trust NAC-I. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility Public Trust NAC-I at this work location.
  • Must be able to obtain Iraq Visa.
  • Must be able to pass CENTCOM Medical requirements for deployment.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Thorough knowledge of aircraft mechanical component troubleshooting, repair procedures, and replacement of parts.
  • Thorough knowledge of aircraft unique tools such as test equipment, torque wrenches, dial indicators, and micrometers.
  • Working knowledge of technical publications and Logistics Information Systems.
  • Able to prioritize workloads to maintain schedules on assigned projects.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.
  • Able to lead teams through more complex aircraft relevant tasks.
  • Possess the level of experience to inspect all required aeronautical type maintenance to be performed by Mechanics.
  • The incumbent receives technical guidance, as required, from supervisor or higher-level technician, and may be required to make entries in aircraft logs and records.

Physical Requirements/Working Environment

  • Must be able to walk and stand on level and/or inclined surfaces for extended periods throughout the day.
  • Must be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands.
  • Must be able to crouch, crawl, grasp or handle objects, use finger dexterity, bend elbow/knee and reach above/below shoulders.
  • May be required to lift heavy objects whose weight may exceed 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to type using a standard keyboard to communicate through e-mail and various software applications.
  • Will handle dirty parts and lubricants.
  • Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • Must be able to pass a Respirator Physical and Fit Test qualification.
  • May be required to operate power vehicles, machinery, hand tools, ground support equipment, fork lift, etc.
  • Must be able to lift/push/pull minimum of 50 pounds.
  • May work in maintenance shop or outside.
  • Must be able to work in a shop where the environment is drafty, noisy, and dirty.
  • May be exposed to extreme noise from operating equipment.
  • May be exposed to electrical shock hazards or work near moving mechanical parts or vehicles.
  • May be expected to work in austere environments and all weather conditions.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. A rede de atenção às urgências e emergências se caracteriza pela rápida resposta aos quadros agudos de natureza clínica ou traumática que ocorrem fora do ambiente hospitalar. É fundamental para garantir suporte e a sobrevivência das pessoas vitimadas por quadros de maior gravidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Prestar assistência segura, humanizada e individualizada, desde a admissão até a transferência de setor, sob supervisão do enfermeiro;
  • Verificar sinais vitais, administrar medicações e realizar procedimentos assistenciais, sempre com foco na segurança e na redução de riscos de infecção;
  • Preencher registros específicos relacionados à assistência e prontuário, conforme normas institucionais e orientação do enfermeiro;
  • Garantir a adequada comunicação entre as equipes durante o plantão;
  • Preparar e prover materiais, equipamentos e insumos necessários para os procedimentos, zelando pela correta utilização e conservação;
  • Auxiliar o médico e prestar suporte na realização de exames e cuidados específicos do paciente;
  • Monitorar o posicionamento de cateteres, sondas e drenos, reportando irregularidades ao enfermeiro;
  • Cumprir as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem e as rotinas institucionais;
  • Realizar procedimentos dentro das técnicas assépticas e seguir orientações do Serviço de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar;
  • Demais atividades pertinentes a função.
Requisitos e qualificações:
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Pós-graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Urgência/Emergência (Pronto Socorro), UTI ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Enfermeiro em urgência/emergência.
Informações adicionais:
  • Atuação na região de Diadema na escala 12x36.
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.
Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you
Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.
Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.
This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.
The role entails

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study
Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Quality Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of the materials used in our products. Your expertise will contribute significantly to our mission of delivering exceptional IIoT solutions to industries worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the design and manufacturing teams to define quality standards, specifications, and inspection criteria for mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Conduct thorough quality assessments of incoming materials, ensuring they meet specified requirements and are free from defects.
  • Develop and implement quality control processes, including inspection plans, testing procedures, and relevant documentation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for any quality issues identified during testing or production, and track these actions to closure.
  • Participate in the design review process to provide insights on potential quality concerns and ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA).
  • Conduct regular audits of manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve component quality, resolve quality-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in the supply chain.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of quality assurance activities, including test results, inspection reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality documentation, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, and quality manuals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Quality Engineer, preferably in a manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity in quality tools, methodologies, and documentation such as 8D, DMAIC, NCR, EA, and statistical process control.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Reading and Writing English proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Experience with plastic injection and mold manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Reliability Engineering and its tools.
  • Spanish proficiency.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

Descrição e Responsabilidades

• Controlar volumes disponíveis de levedo no processo de sangria, maturação, autólise e secagem, através de níveis dos tanques e abertura de válvulas.

• Verificar as manobras de tubulações e equipamentos antes de iniciar o processo, garantir operação e regulagem dos exaustores, bombas, radiadores, bicos aspersores, entradas de vapor, para que não entre excesso de pressão no “corpo” do secador de levedura.

• Efetuar limpeza nos equipamentos, tubulações e estruturas externas do processo de produção de levedura seca, auxiliar quando necessário nas limpezas internas de equipamentos, pisos e estruturas.

• Identificar possíveis falhas de instrumentos e equipamentos e quando necessário fazer a abertura da OS (Ordem de Serviço) e passar para equipe de manutenção, é de sua responsabilidade acompanhar o andamento da execução das OSs em andamento e reportar para os seus pares.

• Acompanhar, interpretar e agir rapidamente com ações efetivas, através dos dados informados pelo laboratório, que estarão disponíveis no sistema.

• Reportar as lideranças, quaisquer anomalias percebidas no processo ou em equipamentos dentro ou fora de sua área de atuação.

• Auxiliar nas operações de fermentação alcoólica, quando necessários e operadores de centrífugas de levedo.

• Garantir o preenchimento correto de todos os formulários que envolvam suas operações, manter-se atualizado quanto aos procedimentos operacionais disponíveis nas pastas, sugerir a liderança revisões e correções quando necessário.

• Manter-se informado sobre as metas e resultados através dos meios de comunicação adotados pela gestão.

• Zelar pela utilização de ferramentas e instrumentos de trabalho, conservando e guardando-os em local adequado.

• Utilizar sempre todos os equipamentos de proteção individual fornecido pela empresa (EPI/EPC).

• Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança e qualidade estabelecidos pela empresa, bem como, utilizar constantemente todos os EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) fornecidos pela empresa e de uso obrigatório, ter a responsabilidade de informar ao seu superior imediato qualquer atividade que apresente risco a sua saúde ou dos demais colegas de trabalho, inclusive tendo o direito de parar qualquer atividade que apresente algum risco grave e iminente de acidente.

• Exercer as atividades em comum acordo com os valores, Ética e conduta, políticas, diretrizes e procedimentos, mantendo sob sigilo e protegendo as informações da empresa.

• Realizar outras atividades correlatadas a comando do superior imediato.

• Trabalhar em conformidade com a segurança do trabalho, saúde ocupacional, sistema de gestão da qualidade e meio ambiente.

• Experiências práticas necessárias ao cargo.

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What will you do

As a Hardware Test Engineer specializing in Mechanics, your primary role will involve conducting rigorous mechanical testing and validation on a variety of hardware products. You will be hands-on in the lab, applying principles of mechanics to assess durability, lifespan, and functionality, ensuring all mechanical components operate effectively under specified conditions and comply with all regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute detailed mechanical test plans, including stress tests, vibration tests, and thermal cycling to evaluate product endurance.
  • Use precision measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, and force gauges to gather accurate test data.
  • Simulate real-world mechanical stresses using test rigs, hydraulic actuators, and environmental chambers.
  • Analyze test results, identify mechanical failures, and collaborate with design engineers to recommend product improvements.
  • Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures, results, and insights for future reference and compliance purposes.
  • Ensure all mechanical testing equipment is calibrated, maintained, and operating correctly.
  • Stay up-to-date with the mechanical testing methodologies and industry best practices.

  • In-depth knowledge of mechanical systems, materials properties, and manufacturing processes.
  • Proficiency in CAD software, such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD, for reviewing mechanical designs.
  • Experience with scripting languages, like Python and MATLAB.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis software like Excel.
  • Familiarity with industry standards for mechanical testing and compliance.

If you enjoy teaching English, spend a summer holiday blessing young Brazilian Christians eager to learn English, preparing them for cross-cultural mission.

Na CRA, você se juntará a mentes líderes que usam análises econômicas, financeiras, técnicas e de negócios para resolver problemas complexos para uma lista impressionante de clientes, incluindo 99% dos 100 maiores escritórios de advocacia, 89% das empresas da Fortune 100 e agências governamentais em todo o mundo. Visão geral do trabalho

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você apoiará a equipe sênior na realização de avaliações de risco de Compliance, investigações contábeis forenses, pesquisa e análise de grande volume de dados. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com colegas no Brasil, nos Estados Unidos e na Europa, mas será fundamentalmente responsável pelo trabalho executado pela companhia do Brasil.

Você será responsável por trabalhar em atribuições de pesquisa, investigações financeiras, litígios e questões de disputa. As responsabilidades podem incluir (mas não se limitam a):

  • Investigar e analisar registros financeiros e contábeis em apoio a diversas investigações financeiras, como apropriação indébita de ativos, corrupção ou fraude nas demonstrações financeiras.
  • Realizar procedimentos contábeis forenses como parte de grandes investigações multidisciplinares que incorporam investigações tradicionais de pesquisas de antecedentes, conjuntos de dados complexos e análises técnicas contábeis ou econômicas.
  • Utilizar históricos econômico, contábil e/ou financeiro para apoiar especialistas seniores.
  • Preparar e apresentar materiais em relação às propostas e reuniões dos clientes.

  • Auxiliar na criação, desenvolvimento e controle de qualidade das entregas de clientes, incluindo análises financeiras, resumos de pesquisas, laudos periciais e outros materiais.

Qualificações

Estamos buscando candidatos para apoiar nossas crescentes ofertas de investigações. Os candidatos ideais devem possuir:

  • 2-4 anos de experiência de trabalho relevante em contabilidade forense ou área relacionada.
  • Fluência em português e inglês é obrigatória, pois essa pessoa interagirá frequentemente com escritórios internacionais.
  • Graduação em disciplinas relacionadas, como administração, direito ou contabilidade, com experiência prévia de consultoria sendo preferencial. Certificações profissionais são favoráveis, mas não necessárias.
  • Vontade de trabalhar em um ambiente empreendedor.
  • Habilidades analíticas, quanto a resolução de problemas e ótima comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de priorizar várias tarefas, gerenciar vários fluxos de trabalho, estar atento aos detalhes e cumprir prazos.
  • Alto nível de iniciativa e curiosidade, ética de trabalho e dedicação à qualidade.

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você terá contato frequente com a liderança sênior e trabalhará em colaboração com os membros da sua equipe.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and go-getter Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join our Data Science team and play a pivotal role in driving the model development/production lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, MLOps, and DataOps teams to implement ML models for assessing transactional risk and fraud, enable automated model retraining, and support robust machine learning inference systems. This role is essential for ensuring efficient, reliable, and scalable workflows to power data-driven insights and machine learning solutions.

  • Model Development and Optimization: Design the data-architecture flow for the efficient implementation of real-time model endpoints and/or batch solutions.
  • Data Exploration and Feature Engineering: Engineer domain-specific features that can enhance model performance and robustness.
  • Productionization of ML Models: Build pipelines to deploy machine learning models in production with a focus on scalability and efficiency, and participate in and enforce the release management process for models and rules.
  • Monitoring, Maintenance & Improvement: Implement systems to monitor model performance, endpoints/feature health, and other business metrics; Create model-retraining pipelines to boost performance, based on monitoring metrics; Model recalibration.
  • Scalable System Design: Design and implement scalable architectures to support real-time/batch solutions; Optimize algorithms and workflows for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency; Ensure systems adhere to company standards for reliability and security.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Conduct research and prototypes to explore novel approaches in ML engineering for addressing emerging risk/fraud patterns.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with fraud analysts, risk managers, and product teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS/Engineering/Data-Science or other technical disciplines.
  • Solid experience in DS/ML engineering.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing batch and real-time streaming pipelines, using SQL and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for data pipelines, streaming systems, and model performance.
  • Experience in AWS cloud services (Sagemaker, EC2, EMR, ECS/EKS, RDS, etc.).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and MLOps platforms like MLflow.

  • Experience with Online Inference, APIs, and services that respond under tight time constraints.

What We'll Bring:

Este ambiente dá ao nosso pessoal a oportunidade de aprimorar as habilidades atuais e construir novas capacidades, descobrindo seus talentos.

Estamos trabalhando para trazer maior representatividade social para a nossa empresa, garantindo que as pessoas se sintam parte de nossas equipes e dando apoio para que conquistem cargos de liderança. Reconhecemos que ainda há trabalho a ser feito e não vamos parar até que todas as pessoas que passem pelas nossas portas diariamente se sintam incluídas. Venha fazer parte da nossa história!

What You'll Bring:

  • Experiência com manipulação de dados: Business Intelligence, Data Quality, Data Governance, Ciência de Dados, Análise de Dados.
  • Conhecimento e experiência em Governança de Dados utilizando frameworks atuais (DAMA, CMMi DMM ou DCAM).
  • Capacidade prática de analisar grandes quantidades de dados, reconhecer padrões e tendências e organizar observações em um formato claro e útil.
  • Conhecimento em MS Excel e bancos de dados (SQL, ETL, Hive, Linguagem R).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Tableau (preferencial) e Power BI.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Capacidade de liderar e gerenciar projetos individuais e junto ao time.
  • Conhecimento em automatização de processos (Integration Services - diferencial).

Impact You'll Make:

Será responsável pelos processos técnicos, definições de dados e regras de dados que criam, governam e informam os dados usados nos produtos e serviços da TransUnion.

  • Liderar projetos de governança de dados com atuação cross nas diversas áreas de dados.
  • Coletar, analisar e sintetizar as informações de uma variedade de conjuntos de dados grandes e/ou complexos para entender o comportamento dos dados de pessoas consumidoras.
  • Desenvolver painéis e relatórios para fornecer insights sobre qualidade de dados e métricas de desempenho para clientes da TransUnion e partes interessadas internas, incluindo operações de dados e grupos de operações de pessoas consumidoras.
  • Resolver desafios complexos relacionados a painéis de qualidade de dados usando análises descritivas e preditivas.
  • Realizar análises de dados ad-hoc para responder a perguntas de negócios e orientar a estratégia.
  • Entendimento de medições de qualidade de dados, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Auxiliar com estimativas de planos e cronogramas de projetos de qualidade de dados.
  • Manter contato com a equipe Global da TransUnion para adequação de processos e uso de ferramentas globais.
  • Monitorar os dashboards e processo de qualidade de dados, endereçando as ações de melhoria junto ao time de soluções.

title: Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling
description:
Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling

Are you looking for a challenging career in business-development? Do you have prior experience and a proven track-record in delivering against targets in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon is looking for a Global Selling Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Your role will be focused on contributing to new business acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager (50% of the time) – helping them to launch and grow their business on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems and tools. Lastly you will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems and tools.
Key job responsibilities
- Identify, prospect and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
- Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets
- Be a business partner for new merchants providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
- Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
- Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory and performance efficiently and to the required standards
- Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants
- Track and report business development results, analyze, interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants
- Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment
A day in the life
A typical day begins with reviewing performance metrics and pipeline status before diving into proactive outreach to potential merchants. Throughout the morning, you'll conduct virtual meetings with new sellers, providing comprehensive onboarding support and guidance through Amazon's Seller Central platform. The afternoon focuses on analyzing merchant data, conducting business reviews, and offering strategic recommendations for growth. You'll continuously monitor category trends, evaluate competitive pricing, and ensure merchants maintain Amazon's high standards for delivery and customer experience. The day involves balancing reactive support with proactive business development, all while tracking progress against quarterly targets and updating necessary reports in the CRM system. Participation in external events may apply.
About the team
Our dynamic, multicultural team is dedicated to expanding Amazon's global marketplace by enabling merchants worldwide to reach international customers. Operating at the intersection of technology and international commerce, we help businesses navigate multiple marketplaces, local regulations, and cultural nuances. Our team combines diverse perspectives from professionals across different regions and languages, working together to break down cross-border selling barriers. We pride ourselves on our data-driven approach, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to merchant success. Join us in shaping the future of global e-commerce while maintaining Amazon's customer-centric focus.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields

With Fastn, companies can launch strategic integrations, create their own app marketplace, and unlock new revenue streams by offering seamless connectivity with the tools their customers already use. As a Senior UX Designer, you'll be the driving force behind user experience design at Fastn. You will lead UX initiatives across our platform, ensuring that every interaction is seamless, intuitive, and empowering for our users. From onboarding to feature discovery, your designs will directly impact product adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

Why Join Fastn?

  • Shape the UX vision of a category-defining integration platform.

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects in over 119 offices in 50 countries worldwide.

Job Description

The Project Manager will take responsibility for end-to-end service delivery, ensuring that client objectives are met through the delivery of an effective service. This includes interfacing with the client and other consultants at all project stages, managing overall project cost, schedule, and budgets, as well as managing general contractors and other directly contracted vendors and consultants.

  • Coordinate and oversee scheduling consultant reviews on the project.

  • Collaborative approach, client-facing, able to develop strong relationships, and confidently present to clients and stakeholders.
  • Be assertive and detail-oriented, identifying potential issues early and raising them in the appropriate forum for resolution.
  • Demonstrable record of accomplishment in the delivery of relevant projects.
  • Advanced skills with spreadsheets, report writing, and presentations.
  • Management experience, with the ability to manage and lead a team in delivering a commission and general line management.
  • Manage revenue, team resources, and priorities to ensure that client expectations are met.

Qualifications

  • Above 7 years' experience working in a similar position.
  • Sector experience, more specifically in Mission Critical and Life Science Construction.
  • Degree in Architecture, Engineering, or other construction-related fields.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

title: Associate Dean Dentistry – Expat
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?

Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB’s beautiful campus attracts students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the Dean of the College of Dentistry .

Job Description

AUIB seeks a strategic, collaborative, values-driven leader to serve as the Associate Dean of the College of Dentistry. The Associate Dean will have an ambitious vision for AUIB Dentistry that harnesses talent, creativity, and diversity. The Associate Dean will support the dean, who is the administrative and educational head of the College of Dentistry.

This Position Will Be Responsible For

  • Recruiting and retaining the college’s clinical faculty and staff in response to programmatic needs and encouraging their professional development.
  • In consultation with the chairs and directors of the concerned departments and divisions and appropriate committees, as specified in the policies, recommend to the college dean the appointment, tenure, promotion, retention, sabbatical leave, annual salary increase and retirement actions of any faculty member and administrative officer of the college.
  • Developing the clinical component of the college’s curriculum of the College.
  • Developing clinical continuing education and post-graduate programs to develop the advanced skills of practicing dentists.
  • Securing, in consultation with the Dean, the necessary accreditation and regulatory affairs associated with the profession and practice of dentistry.
  • Establishing the necessary academic quality assurance system within the college in line with those of the university as a whole leads to programmatic accreditation.
  • Overseeing, in consultation with the Dean, the appointment of academic staff and other technical and support staff of the College.
  • Representing, in the absence of the Dean, the College at meetings of the university, professional associations, governmental agencies, and other groups.
  • Developing the college’s practice and training facilities and creating an environment that facilitates research and scholarly activity.
  • Delegating duties to appropriate individuals or groups whenever indicated.
  • Performing additional tasks as the college dean or other suitable administrative officers of the university may specify.

Required Skills/Abilities

This position requires:

  • DDS, DMD, Ph.D., or the highest professional qualification in dentistry, and be a graduate of an accredited dental school.
  • Leadership experience in relevant academic institutions or universities for at least 10 years.
  • Evidence of academic and research innovations with a track record of scholarly and professional practice leadership in the field.
  • Demonstrated success in enhancing and advancing patient care, education, and research programs.
  • Demonstrated success in securing private, corporate, and/or governmental support to advance the college’s mission.
  • Demonstrated success in managing and leading a complex organization undergoing change.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to listen and understand the needs of faculty, staff, and students; and the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external constituents.
  • Effective decision-making and conflict resolution skills.
  • Solid understanding of dental clinical practice, procedures, and scheduling.
  • Demonstrated accomplishments in research and scholarship.
  • Operational understanding of American university educational systems.
  • Preferred experience working and living in the Middle East.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.

description:

We are the leading shopping mall, residential communities, retail and leisure pioneer across the Middle East, Africa and Asia, serving over 560 million visitors a year. For the past two decades, we have shaped the consumer landscape across the region, transforming the way people shop, live and play, while maintaining a strong sustainability track record and the largest mall in the world to attain LEED Gold EBOM Certification. Role Purpose

The Store Manager – Hypermarket is responsible for ensuring a seamless delivery of service within the assigned Hypermarkets, as well as driving the operations to ensure maximum sales, maximum profitability, optimum stock management, increase in customer satisfaction and continued business growth. The role holder is also responsible for overseeing and implementing action plans for improvement.

Responsibilities

Role Details – Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Hypermarket Strategy Development and Implementation

  • Ensure implementation of MAF Retail’s hypermarket plans in line with the hypermarket strategies and procedures in collaboration with the Head Office and Corporate Office

Commercial Performance

  • Apply qualitative and quantitative analysis to measure and evaluate commercial performance, and provide recommendations to increase profitability and sales turnover

Merchandise and Stock Management

Hypermarket Service Functions

  • Oversee the enhancement of hygiene standards and the hypermarkets safety and security

  • Lead and guide the team to drive and enhance customer service, and facilitate customers’ requirements as per the required standards
  • Lead the services functions to ensure that the hypermarket receives appropriate and efficient support services to run the day-to-day operations
  • Ensure that the hypermarket is in compliance with operating and customer service standards
  • Ensure that the hypermarket is in compliance with the MAF Retail’s health, safety and hygiene standards

Human Capital Responsibilities

  • Provide inputs on training needs and coordinate with the HC department to ensure facilitation of training requirements
  • Develop and implement on the job-training for the team
  • Provide inputs for the development of annual manpower plan
  • Ensure the implementation of MAF Retail’s corporate policies and relevant procedures

Financial Responsibilities

  • Ensure alignment of procedures in accordance with the Delegation of Authority (DOA)
  • Assist in monitoring allocated budget to ensure compliance and highlight possible issues
  • Provide inputs on the preparation of budget when necessary
  • Provide inputs on cost reduction measures

Qualification, Experience & Skills

Minimum Qualifications/Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration
  • Master’s Degree in in Business Administration is preferred

Minimum Experience

  • 8+ years relevant experience in a similar role, 5+ years in a Retail Business

Skills

  • Strong people and negotiation skills – capable to easily build relationships across all levels

You will apply your comprehensive skills in cyber defense, digital forensics, log analysis, and intrusion analysis to address security incidents across our endpoints, network, and cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for prevention, detection, response, and remediation activities, ensuring that information assets and technologies are adequately protected by leveraging various technologies such as Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and more.

You will also leverage your collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with all relevant stakeholders in multicultural and global environments.

Responsibilities

  1. Report to Director to facilitate all phases in the incident response lifecycle
  2. Be involved in various incident prevention projects to improve Security posture
  3. Preparation:
  • Understand different regulatory and compliance requirements like critical time to report, escalation flows, etc.
  • Take part in self-assessment exercises like Tabletop Exercises, Attack Simulations, Red/Purple Team exercises to make sure the incident response process is working smoothly
  • Develop incident response runbooks, playbooks and SOPs with reference to different regulatory requirements
  • Evaluate the incident response readiness of different layers - people, process, technology
  • Detection & Analysis:
    • Respond to the cyber security incidents escalated from various channels including the 24/7 SOC team.
    • Respond to cyber security incidents in compliance with the local authority / regulatory requirements.
    • Assess the risk, impact and scope of the identified security threats
    • Perform deep-dive incident analysis of various data sources by analysing and investigating security related logs against medium-term threats and IOCs
  • Containment, Eradication and Recovery:
    • Communicate with the stakeholders and provide guidance, recommendations to contain and eradicate the security incident
    • Participate in root cause analysis using forensic and other custom tools to identify any sources of compromise and/or malicious activities taking place.
    • Document and present investigative findings for high profile events and other incidents of interest.
  • Post incident activities:
    • Provide lessons learnt meeting to the stakeholders
    • Lead and keep track on the follow-up activities
    • Document the incident in the case management system and provide incident reports
  • Always ready to jump in, in the event of security incidents.

    • Requirements

    • At least 5 years experience in the Cyber Security industry
    • Strong technical and analytical skills
    • Familiar with the cyber security incident response process
    • Familiarity with AI tools and their application in automating security tasks and processes.
    • Hands-on experience on performing incident response activities
    • Have scripting experience like Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go, etc, and the ability to use these skills to aid in responding to incidents involving Windows, Linux, macOS, as well as cloud environment
    • Have knowledge of cybersecurity tools and software like NGFW, EDR, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP, SIEM, other log management platforms, etc.
    • Be familiar with the MITRE ATT&CK Framework and/or Cyber Kill Chain
    • Be passionate on exploring new technologies and having creative initiative to boost the team capabilities
    • Holders of security related certifications is a plus (e.g.Azure , AWS, CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, GREM, or other equivalent)
    • Awareness of regulatory and compliance requirements like GDPR, MAS, PSD2 etc is a plus.

    Preferably

    • Fast learner with can do attitude and ready to get the hands dirty
    • A strong team player who can collaborate with compassion
    • Passionate to learn and willing to put in the extra effort
    • Understand the concept of ownership and accountability coupled with sense of urgency and prioritisation
    • Confidence in handling incidents and managing relevant senior and technical stakeholders
    • Possess business acumen/mindset (not only technical) when making critical decisions

Who We Are

Founded in 2010, Novibet is a leading GameTech company with a strong international presence. We operate in diverse markets, including Greece, Cyprus, Ireland, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador, Finland, Italy, and New Zealand. With offices in Greece, Malta and Brazil, our mission is to deliver unparalleled sports betting and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base.
Why Novibet

At Novibet, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, consecutively from 2021, reflecting our commitment to developing a positive, inclusive, and supportive work environment. Join us, and you will be part of a team of over 1,000 people worldwide that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

What We are looking for

As a TechOps Specialist , you’ll tackle challenging problems, monitor live production systems, and ensure smooth platform operations. Your role includes investigating incidents, escalating issues, and working with development teams to resolve problems quickly. You’ll use tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Kibana), and Octopus Deploy to monitor, troubleshoot, and manage IT operations and deployments. Additionally, you'll document processes and build a knowledge base to improve efficiency. Be ready to adapt, collaborate, and solve real-world issues in a fast-paced environment.


What you will work on

  • Provide 1st level technical support to respond, investigate and resolve escalated incidents and service requests through the internal Service Management system
  • Direct escalation to internal support teams in cases that a resolution is not immediately possible and following up incidents through resolution
  • Perform incident management process taking any necessary steps to restore service and return the platform to normal operations as quickly as possible (Atlassian Jira ITSM)
  • Proactive monitoring of live production environment and event management based on internal dashboards and application health alerts generated by monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Subsequent testing conduction to detect and confirm application defects and external service providers issues, following up with the relevant stakeholders
  • Cooperate with developer teams, providing 1st level real time production logs investigation and retrieval (ELK Stack - Kibana)
  • Perform IT operations procedures in the production environment (Octopus Deploy)
  • Perform release deployment operations in the production environment (Octopus Deploy)
  • Hands-on handling and troubleshooting of a wide variety of support matters
  • Build internal knowledge base and document articles to improve internal incident management process
  • Speedily interpret and analyze data from various sources in a fast-moving and changing environment

What you bring

  • BSc or Academy degree in Information Technology or related field
  • At lease 1-2 years of experience in a production support environment
  • Prior experience in iGaming industry will be considered an asset
  • ITIL Foundation certified or equivalent experience working in an organization adopting ITIL best practices will be a strong asset
  • Experience working in an organization adopting Incident Management and IT operations best practices will be a strong asset
  • Microsoft certifications would be considered as an asset in this area
  • Nice to have experience with monitoring tools and applications such as Grafana, Zabbix, Prometheus, PRTG, Nagios and Kibana
  • Nice to have experience with ITSM tools like Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Opsgenie
  • Willingness to work both day and night shifts in a rotation
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Ability to efficiently solve problems and attention to detail

What we offer

We truly value our people at Novibet! Within our vibrant, dynamic, and fast-paced environment, we encourage everyone to reach their full potential while enjoying every step of the journey. Here’s how we make that happen:

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary and bonus scheme
  • ️Health insurance: Group health & medical insurance package

  • Transportation: Coverage of public transportation expenses

About 40,000 small businesses use our tools to build websites and send out our content. We strive to foster an environment that allows everyone to contribute to our mission in their unique ways. With the belief that diversity propels innovation, we are continually finding ways to cultivate a commitment to diversity and inclusion in our employees, services, and products, as well as in the communities in which we live and work.
Our Employee Benefits
FMG strives to be a top-tier employer. We continually evaluate our benefits and total compensation packages to ensure we offer our employees the most competitive package we can provide.

  • Generous paid Holiday schedule with a paid Winter Holiday Shutdown week
  • Comprehensive paid time off policies including vacation, sick, parental, and bereavement leave

  15. Track and record movement of all types of Government property. This includes movement from one point to another within a contractor’s facility, movement between facilities, for any purpose, and protection during movement.
  16. Assist on the preparation and safeguarding of administrative support files.
  17. Prepare hand receipts for all property custodian/hand receipt holders.
  18. Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Statement of Work (SOW) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
